# Gene Expression Analysis Across cdc15 Arrest Time Points

This project explores **temporal gene expression dynamics** in yeast after cdc15 arrest.  
It includes correlation analysis, individual gene expression profiling, and an interactive Shiny app to explore relationships between time points.

```{r full-analysis, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load required libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
library(shiny)

# 1. Load the data
data_cdc15 <- read.table("/Users/gauri1399/Desktop/Classes/Sem3/Gene expression/Lab2/02_Paul_Spellman.txt", header = TRUE, row.names = 1)

# 2. Compute correlation matrix
cor_matrix <- cor(data_cdc15, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

# 3. Plot correlation heatmap
cor_df <- melt(cor_matrix)
ggplot(cor_df, aes(Var1, Var2, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "darkred", mid ="white", high = "seagreen",
                       midpoint = 0, name = "Correlation") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(title = "Correlation Heatmap of Gene Expression Over Time",
       x = "Time (minutes)", y = "Time (minutes)")

# 4. Gene expression profile for example gene "YAL002W"
gene_id <- "YAL002W"
gene_values <- as.numeric(data_cdc15[gene_id, ])
gene_values[is.na(gene_values)] <- mean(gene_values, na.rm = TRUE)
time_points <- gsub("cdc15_", "", colnames(data_cdc15))

plot(time_points, gene_values, type = "o", col = "blue", lwd = 2,
     xlab = "Time after cdc15 arrest (minutes)",
     ylab = "Expression",
     main = paste("Gene Expression Profile for", gene_id))

# 5. Shiny app to interactively explore correlations
# NOTE: Set eval=FALSE when knitting; run separately in RStudio to use the app
if(interactive()){
  ui <- fluidPage(
    titlePanel("Gene Expression Correlation Across Time Points"),
    sidebarLayout(
      sidebarPanel(
        selectInput('xcol', 'Select X Time Point', choices = colnames(data_cdc15), selected = colnames(data_cdc15)[1]),
        selectInput('ycol', 'Select Y Time Point', choices = colnames(data_cdc15), selected = colnames(data_cdc15)[2]),
        numericInput('clusters', 'Cluster Count', value = 2, min = 1, max = 9)
      ),
      mainPanel(plotOutput("plot1"))
    )
  )
  
  server <- function(input, output) {
    selectedData <- reactive({
      req(input$xcol, input$ycol)
      data.frame(x_data = data_cdc15[[input$xcol]], y_data = data_cdc15[[input$ycol]])
    })
    
    output$plot1 <- renderPlot({
      data <- selectedData()
      correlation <- cor(data$x_data, data$y_data, use = "complete.obs")
      plot(data$x_data, data$y_data,
           main = paste(input$xcol, "vs", input$ycol, "\nCorrelation:", round(correlation, 2)),
           xlab = input$xcol, ylab = input$ycol,
           col = "blue", pch = 16)
    })
  }
  
  shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
}
